description: Find the exact operation in a public API's OpenAPI spec for a task: method, path, parameters, request body fields, auth. Deterministic search, no LLM. Input: {api, query}. Optional {spec_url} if you already know the spec. Costs $0.002 USDC per call via x402 (Base preferred, or Solana); no charge on errors. Free tier: pass free_trial=true (10 calls/day).

free_trial.description: set true to use the free tier (10 calls/day) without payment

query.description: what you want to do, e.g. 'list repository issues'

x402_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload; omit to receive payment requirements

name: api_endpoint
